customer_name: Alumni Association of the University of Michigan (AAUM)
business_problem: AAUM struggled with manual engagement tracking and siloed constituent data, which caused duplicated outreach, inconsistent messaging, and labor-intensive campaign production across alumni programs.
solution_summary: AAUM uses Salesforce as a constituent engagement platform that combines university relationship data, alumni activity, and outreach execution into a shared model. Sales Cloud stores profiles for alumni, donors, volunteers, and event attendees so staff across programs can see contributions, interests, geography, preferred campus, and prior engagement in one place instead of maintaining separate lists. Experience Cloud turns that profile into a personalized alumni portal where constituents can browse and register for opportunities, update preferences, volunteer, and earn badges. Salesforce Analytics then measures participation and retention across segments, while Marketing Cloud automation journeys use the same constituent data to deliver targeted email, social, and text campaigns for events, volunteering, and membership. Built on Salesforce for Education, the stack gives AAUM a shared constituent view and coordinated messaging across departments.

solution_components.name: Sales Cloud
solution_components.role: Stores unified alumni, donor, volunteer, and event engagement profiles.

solution_components.name: Experience Cloud
solution_components.role: Provides the personalized portal for discovery, registration, and profile updates.

solution_components.name: Salesforce Analytics
solution_components.role: Measures engagement, retention, and outreach performance across segments.

solution_components.name: Marketing Cloud
solution_components.role: Delivers personalized constituent journeys across email, social, and text.

solution_components.name: Salesforce for Education
solution_components.role: Provides the education-specific CRM foundation used to coordinate constituent relationships.

data_flow: University and engagement data flows into Sales Cloud, where AAUM builds constituent profiles for alumni, donors, and volunteers. Experience Cloud exposes that data through a personalized portal, Salesforce Analytics measures participation patterns, and Marketing Cloud uses the same profiles to trigger targeted journeys across channels.
business_outcome: AAUM improved membership acquisition and retention, reduced marketing spend, and gave alumni a more relevant digital experience while helping departments collaborate around one constituent view.
metrics: more than 100 alumni clubs and groups
